rationale: Y independently rediscovers and confirms the exact WebSocket-vs-HTTP native-speed streaming asymmetry central to the ground truth's hsliuustc0106/linyueqian threads, and its findings are backed by verbatim, cross-referenced code quotes that make them credible. X's review is elaborate but touches none of the seven ground-truth concerns (no mention of streaming-speed asymmetry, benchmark-script duplication, or missing profiling/VRAM evidence), and its central claims (unconditional mel_head bias flip, six silent IndexTTS-2 regressions) are unverifiable against the diff and were not flagged by any real reviewer, suggesting overreach. Both are concrete and file/line-anchored, but Y's grounding and topical overlap with actual reviewer concerns give it clearly higher recall and precision.
